leads.claim: A hexagonal-shaped disc suspended from a balloon was recovered near Roswell and transported to Wright Field for examination.
leads.why: The document explicitly cites an FBI teletype detailing the recovery and transfer of specific physical debris to a military facility.
leads.custody_chain: Recovered by RAAF personnel, then transported to Wright Field (now Wright-Patterson AFB) via special plane.
leads.government_response: The government later identified the material as a Project MOGUL balloon train and radar reflector.
leads.quote: disc and balloon were being sent to Wright Field... for examination

doc_verdict: The document discusses the recovery of physical debris near Roswell but concludes, based on its own investigation, that the material was part of a classified Project MOGUL balloon train.
